scope: Every readable arm of panels A-C over the full 24 h schedule: first exposure, drug-free regrowth and later exposures. First-window values of A are copied from meropenem_figure2a_multiarm.csv and of B/C from meropenem_figure2bc_initial.csv, except where line tracing reassigned them (panel B 2xMIC; see that file's provenance).
calibration_method: Axis lines and tick marks located in the raster (2-h x ticks; decade y ticks); log10 = 1 is the plot floor.
reading_method: Zoomed strips (4x) with a 0.1-log10 grid at each sampling column; identities assigned by tracing connecting lines between consecutive sampling times, not by marker shape alone. Values to 0.05 log10 with the project's +/-0.3 reading allowance (not an SD). Every reading was overlaid on the source image and checked to land on its marker.

observation_types.upper_only: below the plot floor: the arm's line leaves the axis floor (10 CFU/mL) before the sampling time
observation_types.lower_and_upper: interval: the marker is hidden in a cluster or behind another marker
observation_types.unidentified_series: panel B's second diamond series, which matches no legend arm; excluded from fits

sampling_times: Plotted positions. Panel B's pre-removal samples plot at 4.3 and 16.3 h against removal at 4.8 and 16.8 h; panel C's at 3.3, 11.1 and 19.1 h against 3.2, 11.2 and 19.2 h.
not_done: Panels D-F (means of five isolates) are not read. Panel A's seven arms at 24 h converge between 6.7 and 7.9 and are kept as one interval.
